nodes.label: Module Depth (leverage at interface)
nodes.rationale: Depth is measured as leverage at the interface: a deep module has a large amount of behaviour behind a small interface. A shallow module has an interface nearly as complex as its implementation. Based on Ousterhout's philosophy but uses depth-as-leverage rather than implementation-lines-to-interface-lines ratio.

nodes.label: Deletion Test
nodes.rationale: Imagine deleting a module. If complexity vanishes, the module was a pass-through. If complexity reappears across N callers, the module was earning its keep.
